back: Image: immutable layered template. Container: running instance with a writable layer.
Containers are ephemeral; the volume keeps data across recreate/restart.
Browser uses https://api.domain (public, baked at build). Server code in Docker uses http://api:4000 (internal).
Key auth only, PasswordAuthentication no, PermitRootLogin no, non-root sudo user, test second session first.
Published ports bypass ufw. Bind to 127.0.0.1 and publish only Caddy 80/443.
VPS: cheap, full control, you do ops. PaaS: pricier, managed ops, faster start.
A: IPv4. CNAME: alias to another name. TXT: text/verification.

front: What does Caddy do for you?
back: Reverse proxy + automatic Let's Encrypt certificates + HTTP to HTTPS redirect.
